action_items: P3 testability: data-testid attributes declared in JSX for RN-Web <View>/<TouchableOpacity>/<Text> nodes DO NOT propagate to the DOM for many of the review-request test-ids (sup-action-needed-section, ic-action-needed-section, pending-transfer-card-*, action-transfer-card-*, transfer-approval-card, transfer-approve-btn, transfer-reject-btn, transfer-cancel-btn, transfer-observer-note, build-stamp). Only test-ids landed on ScrollView anchor Views and a few others (case-progress-indicator, transfer-anchor, treatment-timeline, case-progress-chip-*) actually render as data-testid HTML attrs. Recommend switching to nativeID or wrapping in a div-like element / using accessibilityLabel + a stable helper so Playwright can target these components reliably. This is the SAME known RN-Web propagation gap flagged in iteration_303.

P2 console noise: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' printed ~12 times when the Case Transfer card renders (all 3 roles). Investigate TransferApprovalCard.tsx and procedures/[id].tsx around the transfer block for a stray string/whitespace child inside a <View> (common causes: conditional expressions like `{cond && ' '}`, un-wrapped whitespace between JSX siblings, or a raw ternary yielding a string outside <Text>).
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.tsx L232, L400 — TouchableOpacity uses data-testid attr directly; on RN-Web, TouchableOpacity accepts testID (prop) which is auto-mapped to data-testid, but a plain data-testid HTML attr will NOT propagate through the accessibility layer. Convert `data-testid={...}` to `testID={...}` for consistent DOM propagation.
dashboard.tsx L386, L585 — Same issue on the section-wrapping <View>: use `testID` instead of `data-testid`.

TransferApprovalCard.tsx observer branch: `transfer-observer-note`, `transfer-approve-btn`, `transfer-reject-btn`, `transfer-cancel-btn`, `transfer-approval-card` all need to switch from `data-testid` to `testID`.
auth/login.tsx L204 — the Build stamp <Text> uses data-testid instead of testID; the text is visible but the attr does not reach the DOM.

Content ordering fix (main deliverable) is correct: the Case Transfer card renders between the phase chevron pills (case-progress-indicator) and Treatment Progress (treatment-timeline) for all 3 roles, verified via bounding-rect Y offsets.
Old blue 'Case Transfers' section is fully removed — confirmed via body text absence on all 3 role dashboards.
Observer view for IC correctly hides Approve/Reject buttons and shows 'No action needed from you at this stage' info note — role gating works.
